title: Covers, temperature zones and loading space in a 12-metre hose pit oven
summary: Historical Suneng low-temperature hose-heating furnace documents propose a 12 m working length, five small lids, five control zones and five circulation fans. Equal quantities do not establish five independent chambers, a one-to-one lid/zone relationship, or permission to open one lid while other zones continue heating. Review hose loading length, lid opening, zone positions and heating control after opening in one layout drawing.
